items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'She wants me to act like a morphodyte.' I said 'Morphodyte.' That's the word... In New Orleans, we said 'Morphodyte.' 'Morphodice.'

ctx.x: DANNY BARKER: Yeah, like a fairy. "See, when you go in there and close that scene, that will be a terrific laugh." I said, "Well, I don't know about doing that." "You see, I'll show you. Hold your hand like this. Now, snap your fingers, see." [SNAPS] I said, "I'll think about it." She said, "Think about it."

So I had to go back there, and the cats was waitin'? Said, "What did she say?" I said, "She wants me to act like a morphodyte." I said "Morphodyte." That's the word... In New Orleans, we said "Morphodyte." "Morphodice."
For a gay, for a gay guy.
